hw.bp.title: Blood pressure reading check
hw.bp.logic: Each reading must be sys 70–250, dia 40–150, dia < sys, else Invalid. If either reading has sys ≥ 180 or dia ≥ 120 → Crisis (symptom check). Otherwise the average is saved.
hw.bp.source: ACC/AHA hypertensive crisis threshold (≥180/≥120). Needs clinical sign-off.

st.glucose.title: Glucose reading check
st.glucose.logic: Outside 20–600 mg/dL → Invalid. Below the member’s low (from their clinician, default 70) → Low plan with 15-min timer. Otherwise saved neutrally.
st.glucose.source: ADA level 1 hypoglycemia < 70 mg/dL. Needs clinical sign-off.

ca.zone.title: Asthma/COPD zone from action plan
ca.zone.logic: Peak flow outside 50–900 → Invalid. A red symptom or peak flow below the plan’s red threshold → Red. Peak flow below the green threshold or any symptom → Yellow. Otherwise Green. Thresholds come only from the member’s plan.
ca.zone.source: NAEPP asthma action plan zones. Needs pulmonology sign-off.

ea.selfharm.title: Self-harm signal
ea.selfharm.logic: If the member selects a self-harm option the crisis screen opens immediately (988/911).
ea.selfharm.source: Safe messaging guidance. Needs psychiatry sign-off.

rec.manual.title: Manual health value check
rec.manual.logic: Value must be within the plausible range for the chosen test, else held for review. Duplicates of an imported FHIR value (same LOINC, date, value) are not added twice.

ob.age.title: Sign-up: “I’m 18 or older” ticked
ob.age.logic: Confirmed when the item is ticked. Every sign-up route on ob_account (Apple, Google, Create account, Continue on this phone only) asks this first; unticked, it shows a message and goes nowhere.
ob.age.source: Owner decisions P-68 and P-72. Product rule, not clinical.

sf.unplug.reason.title: Strict session: reason before ending early
sf.unplug.reason.logic: A strict session ends early only when a reason chip is selected or a note is typed.
sf.unplug.reason.source: endSession(overrideReason) in pigeons/unplug_api.dart. Product rule, not clinical.

sf.unplug.sentence.title: Small step: typed sentence

params.sentence: I can come back to this later

sf.unplug.sentence.logic: Done when the typed text equals the sentence, ignoring case, extra spaces and a final full stop.

sf.unplug.sum.title: Small step: quick sum
sf.unplug.sum.logic: Done when the answer equals a + b.
